# Hollyhock Bakery

> An invented neighbourhood bakery in Fernvale. Bread, pastries and celebration cakes.

Phone: (503) 555-0119
Address: 214 Quince Street, Fernvale, OR 97999
Hours: Mon–Fri 7am–3pm, Sat 8am–1pm, Sun closed

- [Menu]({{origin}}/menu): what is baked each day
- [Catering]({{origin}}/catering): cakes and platters for events
